messages:
alert-bot: [ALERT] Unusual KMS key usage detected: key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/ingest-key, source=service-account-inference-node@redwood-internal. Count=312 in 5m. Suspicious pattern: cross-region usage.

sam (oncall): seeing this, pulling logs now. assigning roles: containment lead = sam, comms = dana, sec lead = maria.

sam (oncall): Maria, can you confirm if any deploys touched KMS perms in last 24h?

maria (sec-eng): not in our change log. I see an IaC PR touching a binding for infra-service-role yesterday but it was limited to staging. Querying audit logs for binding changes now.

sam (oncall): Tony, can you throttle the service account access and create short deny rule on the egress path to the KMS region? We want to stop further cross-region calls while we investigate.

tony (infra): added network-level deny for that IP range and added a service perimeter rule to restrict region access. Applying now — ETA ~90s.

keisha (sre): tagging autoscaling: we'll pause any autoscale that would spin new nodes using that SA.

sam (oncall): good. Also revoke the SA keys/token if possible (non-disruptive).

tony (infra): rotated the SA key, created new short-lived token for known jobs. All long-lived tokens revoked.

maria (sec-eng): pulled KMS audit logs: I see repeated Decrypt operations from that SA across us-west1 and europe-west1 starting 3:12 UTC. The pattern started after a cron job was modified at 2:50 UTC in a non-prod pipeline that shares the SA via a misconfigured role.

sam (oncall): ok, containment checklist: 1) throttle network (done), 2) revoke tokens (done), 3) add deny on region (done), 4) enable full audit export to sec-logs bucket (in progress).

keisha (sre): audit export enabled to gs://sec-logs/tmp/1760123456 — exporting last 48h.

maria (sec-eng): evidence gathered: list of Decrypt calls (snip):
```
2026-03-20T02:13:04Z tony-worker-23 us-west1 Decrypt key=ingest-key request_id=548f...
2026-03-20T02:14:08Z tony-worker-07 europe-west1 Decrypt key=ingest-key request_id=aa3c...
```
Patterns show same SA and similar call shapes. Suspect mis-bound SA used by staging job leaked to prod via config drift.

sam (oncall): recommended immediate actions: rotate the KMS key (generate new primary version), revoke all old key versions' usage, and update secrets in the small set of verified services. Maria/do we have an immediate ability to rotate without breaking critical flows?

maria (sec-eng): KMS rotation is safe but will require clients to fetch new key versions. We'll coordinate a rolling update. We should create a fallback policy: if a client fails to decrypt, route to fallback region using cached copies.

dana (prod-sec): I'm drafting a short comms note for internal stakeholders: what happened, containment steps, immediate impact (ingest flows degraded for ~10m), next steps. Will post to #incidents after we confirm rotation plan.

sam (oncall): timebox: 30m to plan rotation and deploy. If we cannot rotate safely, we'll revert the misconfigured cron and rebuild SA bindings.

tony (infra): prepping terraform diff to remove SA from non-prod pipeline and force explicit proj-level binding review. Will push a hotfix PR and tag sam/maria.

maria (sec-eng): also adding an audit-based alert to detect cross-region KMS usage for same key from same SA in 5m window. That should reduce time to detect similar regressions.

keisha (sre): logging: saving collectors and kube logs for workers that made the calls. linking them to the ticket.

sam (oncall): update: rotation plan approved. Maria, run key rotation now. Tony, stand by to push client-side secret refresh across nodes. Keisha, monitor errored decrypts and set alert threshold at 5% degraded. Dana, prepare external comms only if we need to notify customers.

maria (sec-eng): starting rotation: creating new key version v2, updating IAM to allow rotation service account, setting v2 primary.

maria (sec-eng): primary switched to v2 at 02:42 UTC. Old key versions disabled for new decrypts.

keisha (sre): seeing a spike of decrypt-failures at 02:43 UTC, but failing requests are in a small subset (5%) and are retrying. Autoscale paused so no new failures expected.

tony (infra): rolling restart of clients completed across 80% of nodes, secrets refreshed. No major errors.

sam (oncall): good. confirm: network deny still in place?

tony (infra): yes, deny remains until we close the incident.

maria (sec-eng): creating follow-up tasks: 1) remove SA from non-prod pipelines and set explicit per-env SAs, 2) add pre-commit IaC check for SA binding diffs, 3) add KMS cross-region alert, 4) add audit log retention 90 days.

keisha (sre): creating a post-incident runbook entry with steps we used and exact commands. Putting it in the ops runbook PR.

sam (oncall): writing up timeline for handoff. We need a short list for next oncall: items that must be monitored and actions to finish. Dana, please take comms.

dana (prod-sec): internal comms posted to #security-updates and #eng-leads. Heads up sent to the CISO. Public customer comms not required at this time.

sam (oncall): Handoff notes for next oncall (copy into #oncall-handoffs):
- Incident ID: sec-1760123456
- Detection: cross-region KMS Decrypt spikes from shared SA, detected 02:12 UTC
- Containment: network deny, SA keys rotated, KMS primary rotated to v2, autoscale paused
- Impact: transient ingest failures (~5%) during rotation window, recovered
- Open tasks: verify all pipelines replaced SA bindings, IaC pre-commit checks, increase audit retention, verify exported logs ingested into SIEM (ticket #INC-8792)
- Who to call: maria (sec-eng), tony (infra), keisha (sre)

sam (oncall): I'm handing off to maria for the detailed follow-ups. Next oncall please pick this up in 2 hours.

maria (sec-eng): acknowledged, taking ownership for follow-ups. I'll file the postmortem and link evidence.

keisha (sre): leaving sticky note to verify there are no residual tokens and that denied rules remain in effect after rotation.

sam (oncall): thanks team. closing war-room. 

alert-bot: Incident sec-1760123456 transitioned to status=contained by sam (oncall) at 1760123720
